verdict.rationale: First-party LangChain docs state that agents call tools on MCP servers through MCPAdapter, which discovers a server's tools and adapts them into LangChain tools, so MCP tools can be wired into LangGraph agents. However, this support sits in the companion LangChain layer rather than LangGraph core, and it rests on a single thin mention. Missing for 10: LangGraph-specific MCP integration docs, transport/auth/configuration details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: LangChain agents call tools defined on MCP servers through MCPAdapter, which discovers a server's tools and adapts them into LangChain tools.
